verses.verse:
गोविन्द करपल्लव पत्रिका भिर्निष्पीडितांगीम् रस वर्धिनीम् वै ।
पूतात्मतत्वादधरोपविष्टाम् राधाम् द्वितीयामनुराधयाम् ।।१।।
verses.text: We worship [the flute], a second Rādhā: her body pressed by the leaf-like fingers of Govinda's tender hands, she increases rasa, and because her inner being is pure she is seated on [his] lips.

commentary.text: The flute which, struck again and again by the leaves, that is the fingers, of Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa's tender-shoot hands, became rasa-vardhinī (one who increases rasa, aesthetic flavour); and which, being hollow like a soul free of deceit and guile, came to be seated on the Lord's adhara (lips), as if it were Śrī Kṛṣṇa's second Rādhā: such a flute we worship again and again.
